newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 8.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Oct. 8:
WASHINGTON - CyberCash Inc of Reston announced an alliance with Netscape Communications Corp that could give much wider currency to the company's system for making retail purchases on the Internet.
WASHINGTON - Three big oil firms - Shell Oil Co, Texaco Inc and Star Enterprises - are mulling a joint venture combining refining and marketing operations in the United States.

NEW YORK - The Dow Jones industrial average's first ever move above the 6,000 level was fleeting but other stock measures edged to new highs as investors braced for a blizzard of third-quarter earnings reports.
